accepted.reason: Pad 0 of J4 (a mounting pin) is on no net upstream; the symbol the import draws has one pin per pad number, so the build puts the pad on a single-pad unconnected-(...) net. Electrically the same; see boards/ISSUES.md.

The import writes a footprint instance that differs from the first footprint of its name (moved fields, edited pads) as a variant footprint <name>_<n> (import.footprint-variant); checked on 2026-10-30: in all 135 differences the built name is the upstream name plus '_<n>'. Footprint-instance overrides (change c0277) will remove this.
Dimension: the DSL has no dimension call yet (change c0277), so the import left it out (import.item-unexpressed, kind dimension).

The build adds the property fenolite.path (the layout lens key) to every footprint; the original has no such field. Not a difference of the design.
Reference field of a bottom-side footprint: rotation 270 degrees upstream, 90 degrees after the round trip through the derived variant footprint. Fenolite bug, see boards/ISSUES.md.
